title: Why Citigroup Just Cut Its Bitcoin and Ethereum Price Forecasts
summary:

Citigroup today trimmed its 12-month forecasts for Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH), citing weaker institutional demand amid the recent market selloff. For Bitcoin, the bank has lowered its target from $113,000, given on October 1, to $99,532. Meanwhile, Ethereum’s projection was shifted from an initial $3,028 to $2,838. At press time, Bitcoin was trading at …
content: Citigroup has lowered its 12-month price forecasts for Bitcoin and Ethereum, pointing to weaker institutional demand following a recent market selloff. The bank reduced its Bitcoin target and also lowered its projection for Ethereum, reflecting cautious sentiment among major market participants during the ongoing market downturn.
